notes.title: New Game Darkzan Arena
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41474569/945e3d030a4df84e090262f218b6d2e390ad4476.png[/img]

[h3]Hello my adventurers, are you ready for another adventure???
I come to inform you about my new game, Darkzan Arena, following the Adventure Rush line but going much further! Graphics! Mechanics! Enemies! Item! Everything you ever dreamed of![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41474569/288efd6313837d387507d50e111a10de486d9f25.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41474569/368c39851ff26db2e5752defd85e3863bafe0989.gif[/img]

Challenge the greatest legends and creatures in this epic coliseum! Collect your treasures and upgrade your gears until you become number one in the entire multiverse.
The game is an Arcade based on waves of enemies, each enemy has a unique behavior and a list of specific rewards.
A complex system of damage, experience, combat and resistance makes it necessary for the player to develop skills to get further and further, all of this mixed with a fluid and fun progress system that allows you to be the best with each accumulated victory!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2320400/Darkzan_Arena/]Add Darkzan Arena to your Wishlist right now! 
[/url]

notes.title: Distant Lands
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41474569/42b7a6f3b2f371a5b6df0bf19fe0c386b9f51cd8.png[/img]

A big hello to all the adventurers, it has been many thrills since the initial release of Adventure Rush, thousands of points have been scored and foods collected!!!
I want to thank everyone who bought and supported this game!
Thinking fondly of you all I would like to announce a totally free expansion for all players!!!

5 New Maps 
5 New Bosses
New Enemies 
New Heroes
New adventures await you in Distant Lands!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41474569/24bbe7519f1d6e74df351196f266f7bd521b570e.png[/img]

Special thanks to Jubarte and NanaJinnie for all the support and work <3

notes.title: Adventure Rush release date!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41474569/42b7a6f3b2f371a5b6df0bf19fe0c386b9f51cd8.png[/img]
